fact: Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 provides that every death must be declared and recorded in the communal register of natural persons and immediately taken into account in the National Register of Natural Persons.
title: Décret fixant les modalités d'inscription et de tenue du Registre National des Personnes Physiques en République de Guinée (D/2025/052/PRG/CNRD/SGG)
